extensionDescription.message: Mark any YouTube video as watched on your account in one click, without telling the algorithm you're not interested.
extensionDescription.description: Add-on description shown in the add-ons manager.

menuMarkWatched.description: Context menu item shown when right-clicking a video link.

buttonMark.description: Button label on thumbnails and on the video page, before marking.

buttonMarking.description: Button label while the request is in progress.

buttonWatched.description: Button label once the video is marked as watched.

buttonTitleMark.message: Add this video to your YouTube watch history
buttonTitleMark.description: Tooltip of the button before marking.

buttonTitleWatched.description: Tooltip of the button once marked.

errorInvalidLink.message: This link isn't a YouTube video.
errorInvalidLink.description: Error: the link has no recognizable video ID.

errorPageUnavailable.description: Error: fetching the watch page failed.

errorNotLoggedIn.message: You're not signed in to YouTube.

errorNoPlayerData.description: Error: the watch page didn't contain the expected player data.

errorNoTracking.message: YouTube doesn't allow marking this video as watched.
errorNoTracking.description: Error: the player data has no watch-tracking URLs (e.g. unavailable or restricted video).

errorUnknown.message: Couldn't mark the video as watched: $DETAIL$

detail.example: NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource.
